Body.Content: We’ve announced a new Azure Virtual Private Network (VPN) Gateway that allows you to connect your virtual network via ExpressRoute and site-to-site VPN. It also provides higher throughput for ExpressRoute than the current dynamic routing VPN gateway. For more information, please visit the VPN Devices documentation page. For pricing information, please visit the Virtual Network Pricing page.
Body.Markdown:
We’ve announced a new Azure Virtual Private Network (VPN) Gateway that allows you to connect your virtual network via ExpressRoute and site-to-site VPN. It also provides higher throughput for ExpressRoute than the current dynamic routing VPN gateway.

For more information, please visit the VPN Devices documentation page. For pricing information, please visit the Virtual Network Pricing page.
